art_direction: Minimal lateral 2D dark-fantasy pixel art: large readable pixel clusters, sparse cool blue-violet night palette, warm amber fire contrast, restrained detail, clean silhouettes, no copied external designs.

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: six-panel wordless opening comic reference for a 2D pixel-art game. Primary request: show a Thalestriel family fleeing through a cold dark-fantasy night, carrying a few clearly precious ancestral relics to their open horse-less wagon; show plague exhaustion among eight companions; show arrival at a root-lined cave where the wagon has a broken wheel and splintered wood; end with Lolth standing ready to explore while the eight sick allies rest in the cave camp. Style: minimal lateral 2D pixel art, large pixel clusters, cool blue-violet shadows, small amber campfire light, cinematic panel gutters. Constraints: Lolth is the only active explorer; wagon is open, no horse, no second vehicle, no abandonment, no explicit gore, no readable text, no watermark, no logo, no UI.
